description: This file defines an abstract class 'StreamSequenceToken' representing a stream sequence number/token, along with a static utility class for comparing these tokens. It is part of the Orleans.Streams namespace and appears to be a core component for managing stream subscriptions and ordering.

classes.name: StreamSequenceToken
classes.description: Handle representing stream sequence number/token, with sequence number and event index.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Abstract method to determine equality between stream sequence tokens.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Abstract method to compare two stream sequence tokens.

methods.name: Newer
methods.description: Extension method to determine if one token is newer (greater) than another.

methods.name: Older
methods.description: Extension method to determine if one token is older (lesser) than another.
